purpose: Measure scoring-layer crosstalk, latent-subspace recovery, and downstream transition recoverability under the exact primary and sensitivity regulon geometries before freezing any promotable B3 dimension rule.

latent_truth_generation.eigenvalue_rule: For dimension d, use d real eigenvalues linearly spaced from 0.55 through 0.90, conjugated by a seed-fixed random orthogonal matrix.
latent_truth_generation.initial_state_rule: Seed-fixed N(0,1) vector normalized to Euclidean norm 1.
latent_truth_generation.treatment_forcing_rule: Independent seed-fixed N(0,1) vector normalized to Euclidean norm 0.35 and applied on every treated transition only.
latent_truth_generation.regulator_loading_rule: For every eligible regulator independently draw d seed-fixed N(0,1) loadings and normalize that regulator loading row to unit Euclidean norm. No expression outcome may alter loadings.

synthetic_expression_generation.network_matrix: Eligible regulator-by-measured-target matrix using the frozen signed scoring weights.
synthetic_expression_generation.generation_normalization: Normalize each regulator row of the network matrix to unit L2 norm for synthetic signal generation only, preventing target-count magnitude from defining known-truth activity amplitude. ULM scoring still uses the original frozen network weights.
synthetic_expression_generation.noise: Independent Gaussian feature noise with sigma = declared noise_fraction * global SD(X_signal).
synthetic_expression_generation.unmeasured_or_nonnetwork_features: Retain the complete frozen mapped GSE98812 symbol universe; features with no eligible-network edge receive noise only.
synthetic_expression_generation.synthetic_values_semantics: continuous normalized feature statistics suitable for ULM; no claim of raw-count realism

scoring.network_and_identifier_rules: inherit parent B3 scoring freeze without modification

regulator_activity: per-regulator Pearson correlation between known activity and recovered ULM t-value when both have nonzero variance
latent_subspace: principal-angle cosines between centered known latent state and the first d recovered ULM score components
control_only_state_projection: fit d-dimensional PCA basis on recovered control ULM scores only
project all 22 synthetic states through that control-only basis
transition_recovery: fit the already-qualified D1 shared-transition-plus-treatment-input model to the recovered control-only PCA state
report design rank and scaled condition number

reason_thresholds_absent: This is explicitly a representative run-economy pilot. It may expose scaling, crosstalk, numerical pathologies, and effect sizes used to design a separately frozen holdout validation gate, but it cannot promote a dimension or representation.
hard_guards: Do not use pilot results to open real SCC25 or TCGA activity scoring.
Do not select the more favorable network representation as primary; CollecTRI remains primary and DoRothEA ABC remains sensitivity.
Do not compute normalized G1 because restoration remains unresolved.
Do not tune synthetic truth toward unity.
Do not redefine ULM, target eligibility, identifier mapping, or network weights after pilot inspection.
